title: Glowing Christmas tree
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='starGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFDE0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='lampGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFEA80'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FFB020'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E05000'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- trunk -->
  <rect x='45' y='82' width='10' height='13' rx='2' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='45' y='82' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A8703A'/>
  <!-- tree tiers, lightest at top -->
  <polygon points='50,12 64,36 36,36' fill='#3BB24A'/>
  <polygon points='50,12 64,36 36,36' fill='none' stroke='#6BE07A' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='50,30 72,56 28,56' fill='#2E9E3D'/>
  <polygon points='50,30 72,56 28,56' fill='none' stroke='#5ED46F' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='50,50 80,80 20,80' fill='#238A32'/>
  <polygon points='50,50 80,80 20,80' fill='none' stroke='#4FC860' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- snow caps on tier tips -->
  <polygon points='50,12 57,22 43,22' fill='#EAF6FF' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- star -->
  <polygon points='50,4 52.4,9.5 58,9 54,13.2 56,19 50.8,16 45.6,19 47.6,13.2 43.6,9 49.2,9.5' fill='url(#starGlow)' stroke='#FFF6B0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- ornaments: contrasting bright colours -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='3' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='1' fill='#FFC2CE'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='3' fill='#4DC3FF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='1' fill='#C9EEFF'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='48' r='3.2' fill='#FFD93B'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='48' r='1.1' fill='#FFF6C0'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='50' r='3.2' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='50' r='1.1' fill='#FFC2CE'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='68' r='3.4' fill='#4DC3FF'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='68' r='1.2' fill='#C9EEFF'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='70' r='3.4' fill='#FFD93B'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='70' r='1.2' fill='#FFF6C0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='3.4' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='1.2' fill='#FFC2CE'/>
  <!-- glowing fairy lights: warm glow dots -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='20' r='2.2' fill='url(#lampGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='2.2' fill='url(#lampGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='58' r='2.2' fill='url(#lampGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='74' r='2.2' fill='url(#lampGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='74' r='2.2' fill='url(#lampGlow)'/>
</svg>
